zh.title: 优化
items: 下载更新时的图标现在会跟随浅色/深色主题自动切换，不再出现两张图标叠加的情况。

zh.title: 修复
items: 修复 macOS 上自动更新报「代码签名校验失败」导致无法更新的问题：现在会自动下载安装包并在下载完成后引导你打开，手动拖入「应用程序」即可完成更新。
修复从历史消息分叉新建会话时，新会话因丢失工作区归属而在左侧列表被隐藏的问题。

en.title: Improvements
items: The download-update icon now follows light/dark theme automatically, without stacking two icons.

en.title: Fixes
items: Fixed macOS auto-update failures caused by “code signature verification failed”: the app now downloads the installer and guides you to open it so you can drag it into Applications.
Fixed sessions forked from history being hidden in the sidebar after losing workspace ownership.
